tools.name: arbor.open_in_playroom
tools.description: Given an Arbor component name (PascalCase), return the Playroom URL with the canonical snippet pre-loaded. Use coverage="mapped" responses with high confidence; coverage="fallback" responses are best-effort name matching; coverage="not_found" responses link to the Playroom homepage.

componentName.description: Arbor PascalCase component name, e.g. "Button" or "HeaderBar"
